attributes.additional_details: Without fox hunting, unmanaged fox populations have surged in residential areas, spreading diseases and dangerous parasites. Constant digging and fouling make gardening virtually impossible. Furthermore, foxes straying onto motorways pose severe hazards to drivers, while rising incidents—including reports of foxes invading homes and attacking babies—demonstrate an urgent public safety threat. We urge Parliament to restore regulated hunting to protect homes, health, and roads.
attributes.background: Unmanaged foxes carry parasites, destroy gardens, and pose rising safety risks Blanket bans harm rural jobs and pest control. We urge Parliament to repeal hunting bans and introduce statutory licensing to protect property, public health, and rural heritage. NHS statistics prove increased fox attacks

rejection.details: Foxes can already be legally hunted and controlled in certain circumstances, so we're not sure what further action you'd like the Government to take.
